en: Ask the airline for the reason: weather or an air-traffic strike would cancel it; a technical fault or crew shortage would not.
Worked out from the published rules (EU 261, UK 261, Canada's APPR). Airlines sometimes refuse at first — a polite second letter or the national enforcement body usually settles it.

Told 7–13 days ahead: not owed if they offered a flight leaving at most 2 h earlier and arriving at most 4 h later than yours.
Told under 7 days ahead: not owed only if they offered a flight leaving at most 1 h earlier and arriving at most 2 h later than yours.
Owed when the delay was within the airline's control and not for safety. Claim within 1 year.
